newsitem.title: USA: General Signal sees Q1 EPS below last year.
newsitem.headline: General Signal sees Q1 EPS below last year.

text.p: General Signal said Wednesday it expects first quarter earnings per share to be about seven percent below last year's $0.50 because of lower order and revenue expectations and cost pressures.
General Signal said it attributed the shortfall from analysts' consensus of about $0.53 to the company's uninterruptible power supply, fire systems and pump businesses.
Initiatives have already been taken to bring costs in line with future revenue expectations, General Signal said.

"As a result of these corrective actions," said Michael Lockhart, chairman and chief executive, "we are optimistic that the company can still bring the full year into line with "street" expectations."
